text_blocks.snippet: It's generally recommended to wait at least 3 months after having COVID-19 before getting an updated COVID-19 vaccine. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says you should also get an updated COVID-19 vaccine at least 2 months after your last COVID-19 shot. This is because both natural infection and vaccination can provide some level of protection, and waiting allows your body's immune response to natural infection to wane somewhat before introducing the vaccine.
